_about: Daily reels for Instagram + Facebook, GTA and Southern Ontario only for now (the pre-built maps cover Ontario). The workflow posts one entry per day, cycling in order. Keys: city, hook, people ('Name@lat,lon|...'), optional mode (drive|transit|bike|walk), goal (fair|balanced|total), want (any|food|drinks|coffee|activity|free), feature (venue|top5|leave|compare|open|parking|free|mode), when ('HH:MM'), place, caption.
